messages:
sam: FYI we're seeing a surge of 502/504s + long-tail streaming truncations from hosted inference in us-west-2. Customers reported first errors ~14:10UTC. tickets from Tenant-A and Tenant-B attached.
priya: looking at envoy traces now. pattern: upstream connection resets at keepalive boundary, then retries fan out and client sees 504. I also see auth refresh spikes around the same timestamps.
leo: can repro locally with a streaming session + forced token refresh. planning a small replay on canary.
amanda: customers say failures happen for prompts >8k tokens and streaming >20s — likely a keepalive + mid-stream auth refresh interaction.
priya: logs show: `upstream reset: code=CONNECT_ERROR, transport: read reset` and an auth call returning 401 then refresh attempts. Auth service CPU climbs briefly in the window.
infra-bot: alert: hosted-gateway-us-west-2 5xx rate increased, 14:08-14:22UTC, p95 latency x4.
sam: support: triaging as high priority, multiple customers report truncated streams within ~5m.
leo: repro plan: 1) open streaming session, 2) send large prompt, 3) pause at ~12k tokens for 25s (to hit keepalive), 4) trigger token refresh concurrently. Running 50 requests on canary now.
priya: mitigation options on table:
- bump envoy upstream idle_keepalive to 40s in us-west (short-term)
- tighten gateway retry/circuit-breaker to minimize retry fanout
- temporary per-tenant throttle for automated token refreshes
- route auth refresh to a faster read path if available
sam: risk for envoy change?
priya: low risk config change. we can roll in a controlled ASG rolling restart. ETA ~12m to complete region if approved.
amanda: product/comms: prepare short note for affected customers if we're going to touch config.
leo: replay snippet I'm running:
```
for i in range(50):
  open_stream()
  send_large_prompt()
  sleep(25)
  trigger_token_refresh()
```
leo: initial run: 10/50 had truncated streams with upstream reset; p95 spikes align with envoys hitting idle timeout then retries.
priya: observed auth refresh RPS spike for Tenant-B during the same window; auth service k90 CPU elevated.
sam: sending interim customer message: "We're investigating intermittent streaming truncations in us-west-2; temporary mitigation planned; update in 30m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
priya: I'll roll the keepalive bump to 40s in us-west now and add a 15m token-refresh throttle per tenant.
deploy-bot: started rollout: envoy-config-rollout/us-west-2 (change-id: cfg-598765) — status: in-progress
leo: after 20% of envoys rolled, replay results improved: truncated streams down to 2/50.
priya: rollout complete across us-west. monitoring p95 and 5xx counts.
infra-bot: update: 5xx rate decreasing, p95 returning to baseline over last 3m.
sam: good, I'll close immediate escalations and send updated note to customers.
amanda: postmortem owners and action items I want captured:
- RCA: auth refresh race at streaming keepalive boundary causing upstream resets + retry fanout
- Short-term durable config: keepalive=40s in envoys for streaming routes
- Medium-term: tune gateway circuit-breaker/retry budgets for streaming-heavy tenants
- Telemetry: add flag/metric for sessions with mid-stream auth refresh and truncated streams
- Tests: add integration test in runtime harness that simulates mid-stream auth refresh
- Comms: customer template + SLA impact assessment
- Validation: run replay across eu/apac to ensure no regressions
(owners: priya for envoy change, leo for replay/tests, sam for customer comms, amanda postmortem owner)
priya: immediate checklist I'll post in the postmortem: config change id, rollout timeline, rate-limit applied, links to envoy roll runbooks and ASG restart playbook.
leo: note for follow-up: create a unit/integration test that opens a streaming session, triggers auth refresh mid-stream, asserts no truncated stream. add to runtime CI harness.
amanda: scheduling a follow-up sync tomorrow 15:00UTC to review postmortem draft and action timelines. I'll own the postmortem doc and due dates.
sam: adding incident tracker entry and closing war-room once postmortem exists. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
